To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
I40 technologies create sustainable organizational value when deployed in FM with a worker centred approach.

I40 technologies in flexible manufacturing lead to sustainable value creation when they are implemented with a worker centred approach, which allows to leverage workforce activities to continuously improve processes and to exploit the adaptiveness of I40 technologies.
Industry 4. 0 technologies can be leveraged to create sustainable organizational value when organizations adopt a worker centric perspective.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the value created by I40 technologies in the context of FM.
understanding how I40 technologies can be used to improve sustainability in manufacturing organizations.
the value of I40 technologies in manufacturing organizations and how the value is created in a sustainable manner.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the implementation of I40 technologies in flexible manufacturing can support sustainable organizational value, but only in the presence of a workforce that is empowered to continuously fine tune these technologies and to exploit their adaptive features to continuously improve the manufacturing processes.
Industry 4. 0 technologies can support sustainable organizational value creation when they are deployed in flexible manufacturing with a worker-centric approach.
I40 technologies in flexible manufacturing can create sustainable organizational value if they are deployed with worker centric approach and with a continuous improvement mindset.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

I40 technologies in flexible manufacturing are sustainable if they are deployed with an employee centric approach, where employees are the key actors in the continuous fine tuning and improvement of the technologies and the production processes.
I40 technologies in flexible manufacturing can create a sustainable value in manufacturing organizations when they are deployed in a worker centric way.
I40 technologies can create sustainable value for manufacturing organizations when they are used as a platform for workers’ activities and not as a substitute for them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adoption of I40 technologies in manufacturing organizations is not a zero sum game.
I40 technologies in the context of FM can be a source of sustainable value when the organization adopts an approach that is centred on the workers and their activities.
the adoption of I40 technologies is not sufficient per se to create sustainable organizational value.
